title: Moving the input and a register head
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration with $m$ Boolean work tapes, state set $\Lambda$, and fixed input $x$. Given states $s,s'\in\Lambda$, an input-head position $ip\in\mathrm{Fin}(|x|+2)$, a register $r\in\mathrm{Fin}(m)$, an integer $p$, and input and register movements $mv_I,mv_R\in\{-1,0,1\}$, applying the action that moves those heads by the respective movements and enters $s'$ to the configuration obtained from $c$ by setting its state to $s$, input-head position to $ip$, and register-head position to $p$ gives the configuration with state $s'$, input-head position obtained by the clamped move from $ip$ by $mv_I$, and register-head position $p+mv_R$. All other configuration data are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $c$ for $m$ Boolean work tapes, state set $\Lambda$, and input $x$
